description: Custom contract analyzer for Module 3 — extracts and infers fields from legal contracts

Summary.description: A concise 2-3 sentence summary of the contract

Parties.description: All parties named in the contract

EffectiveDate.description: The effective date or start date of the contract

ExpirationDate.description: The expiration or end date of the contract

KeyObligations.description: The key obligations and responsibilities defined in the contract

RiskLevel.description: Overall risk level assessment: Low, Medium, or High, based on liability clauses, penalties, and obligations

Sentiment.description: Overall sentiment of the contract language: Favorable, Neutral, or Unfavorable
